Subject: Onboarding: Console + API enablement — suggested windows

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the trial keys — excited to get our engineers up to speed. We need a combined console walkthrough and API enablement session for Zuni Health. Rough constraints: 6 internal engineers (2 infra, 2 product, 2 app dev), prefer a single contiguous block if possible, and we'd like the session recorded.

Two candidate windows from our side:
- Wed Nov 12, 11:00–13:00 PT (preferred)
- Thu Nov 13, 09:00–11:00 PT (backup)

Also worth noting: a couple of folks in our Singapore office may try to join late — is there a clean way to accommodate late joins without repeating core steps? We want a concise runbook/slide set so attendees can self-serve afterwards.

Can you confirm capacity and whether you recommend a single compact 90–120 minute session or split into Console + API blocks?

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations, Zuni Health

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com

Date: 2025-11-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Console + API enablement — suggested windows

Samir — thanks for the windows and context. Short answer: we can do either, but given the mixed attendee roles I recommend a compact, two-part session to reduce repeat content and keep the recording useful. Proposal below.

Proposal (compact + optional office hours):
- Day 1, Wed Nov 12, 11:00–12:30 PT — Compact walkthrough (90m): 45m Console walkthrough (core flows: project setup, model routing, keys/roles) + 40m API deep-dive (auth flows, batching, KV cache tips) + 5m wrap.
- Day 2, Thu Nov 13, 10:00–10:45 PT — Optional office hours for hands-on troubleshooting and followups.

Why this structure: it keeps the main learning consolidated for recording, then gives a short, low-cost followup for hands-on items (credential access, sandbox hiccups). For late APAC joiners: we can record the first 45 minutes and provide time-stamped runbook notes; if they arrive late we’ll surface a 10–12 minute recap segment near the 60-minute mark.

Pre-reqs for Nov 12 session:
- SSO/SAML test account for at least one engineer (please share by Mon 11/10).
- One service account API key provisioned in the sandbox.
- Confirm whether you want token rotation discussed in detail (it adds ~10–15m).

I’ve attached a compact runbook and a draft calendar invite (ICS). If you confirm the 11:00 PT slot I’ll finalize invites and prep the short slide deck.

Thanks — tagging Lauren to coordinate host/reserve the session.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: compact_onboard_runbook_v1.pdf, zuni-calendar-invite.ics

Hi Aditya / Team,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of updates from our side that complicate the morning slot: two of our key app developers will be in APAC and can join reliably only in the evening PT window (their morning). Can you run the compact session in the evening on Nov 12 instead? Proposed: Nov 12, 18:00–20:00 PT.

Also second ask: we have a strong interest in a deeper API segment that covers token auth, key rotation, and a short troubleshooting checklist for common 401/429 issues — can that be expanded to ensure our infra team gets sequence-level tips? If that adds time we can be flexible on start/end times.

Recording required. Also please keep an eye on bandwidth — we will have folks on VPN with variable throughput.

Thanks, Elena
Elena Morgan
Platform Lead, Zuni Health

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Elena / Samir — thanks for flagging the APAC constraint. We can accommodate the evening window on Nov 12 and will slightly reflow the agenda to ensure both groups get high-value content without duplication. Finalized plan below: 

Nov 12 — Redwood <> Zuni Health (single evening block)
- 18:00–18:45 PT — Console: essential flows + quick access checks (recorded, timestamps for APAC)
- 18:45–18:55 PT — 10 min break / rapid Q&A triage
- 18:55–20:10 PT — API deep-dive: auth patterns, service account best practices, key rotation demo, common 401/429 mitigation patterns (we’ll record both segments)

Notes and logistics:
- We’re allocating 80 minutes for the API segment to cover rotation and sequence-level tips. If you prefer a hard stop at 20:00 PT we can compress to 60–70 minutes — please confirm.
- I’ve attached an updated slide deck and the API deep-dive slides. We’ll also publish time-stamped timestamps in the runbook post-session.
- Action items for Zuni: share one SSO test account and an API sandbox key by Nov 11 COB; let us know if any attendee requires VPN-friendly low-bandwidth settings (we can reduce screen-motion and send additional code snippets ahead of time).

I’ll send the final calendar invite (evening slot) once you confirm the 18:00 start. Ben, can you be the backup host and manage recording and breakout notes?

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
